title: GitHub Copilot for Eclipse is now open source
description: GitHub announced that Copilot for Eclipse is now open source under the MIT license, allowing community contributions and transparency. The code is now hosted publicly on GitHub.

title: Semantic issue search in Copilot Chat
description: New semantic search capability allows Copilot Chat to understand and find issues based on meaning rather than just keywords, improving the accuracy of code-related queries.

title: Gemini 3.5 Flash is generally available for GitHub Copilot
description: Google's Gemini 3.5 Flash model is now generally available for GitHub Copilot users. Early testing shows it delivers near-Pro coding quality at Flash-tier speed with 42% better performance on multi-turn cyber benchmarks and 72% reduction in token use.

community_feedback.quote: I agree, 2.5 Pro was an absolute nightmare for coding via GitHub Copilot
Do you really need a smarter model than Gemini 3 Flash? - Active debate about model selection
Early testing shows strong tool use, fast response times, and near-Pro coding quality at Flash-tier speed and cost

title: Copilot cloud agent: Fast, cost-efficient models for simple tasks
description: New cloud agent can automatically route simple tasks to faster, more cost-efficient models while reserving premium models for complex work. Uses flat-rate pricing at approximately $0.04 per premium request.

community_feedback.quote: The agent can become quite expensive due to premium request limits
The biggest benefit is the flat-rate pricing model versus per-token pricing
$10/month is efficient compared to raw GPT-4 API costs ($0.03-0.06 per 1K tokens)

title: Ask questions in context with Copilot on web
description: New web interface feature allows users to ask questions with repository context directly in the browser, enabling AI-assisted code exploration without leaving the web interface.

title: Copilot Spaces API now generally available
description: The Copilot Spaces API is now generally available, enabling developers to programmatically manage and interact with Copilot Spaces for collaborative AI coding environments.

title: Remote control for Copilot CLI sessions now generally available
description: Remote control functionality for Copilot CLI sessions is now available across mobile, web, and VS Code platforms, allowing developers to control CLI sessions from anywhere.

title: GPT-5.3-Codex is now the base model for Copilot Business and Enterprise
description: OpenAI's GPT-5.3-Codex model is now the default base model for Copilot Business and Enterprise tiers, providing improved code generation capabilities.

title: Bug Fixes and Improvements v2.3.9
description: Fixed availability issues with swe-check model for some users, improved terminal processing performance, restored conversation sharing, and repaired path resolution for Devin local agent on WSL.

title: GitHub Copilot app now available in technical preview
description: A new standalone GitHub Copilot application is now available in technical preview, offering an alternative to IDE-specific installations.

title: Team-level Copilot usage metrics now available via API
description: New API endpoints provide team-level usage metrics for Copilot, helping organizations track adoption and usage patterns across teams.

title: Cursor Automations in Agents Window and Multi-Repo Support
description: Cursor Automations are now available in the Agents Window, with support for multiple attached repos or no repos at all. New no-repo automation templates include Slack digest, product analytics, FAQ, finance, and customer health agents.

title: Cursor in Jira Integration
description: Cursor is now available in Jira. Users can assign work items to Cursor or mention @Cursor in comments to kick off cloud agents. The integration uses work item context to scope tasks and shows completion updates with PR links.

title: Composer 2.5 Release
description: Composer 2.5 is now available with substantial improvements in intelligence and behavior over Composer 2. Better at sustained work on long-running tasks, follows complex instructions more reliably. Standard tier: $0.50/M input, $2.50/M output; Fast tier: $3.00/M input, $15.00/M output.

title: Full-Screen Tabs and Compact Chats
description: New quality-of-life improvements for the Agents Window including full-screen tabs to maximize the right panel, and compact chat responses with customizable tool call density (compact, balanced, detailed).

title: Development Environments for Cloud Agents
description: New tools for configuring development environments for cloud agents, including multi-repo environments, Dockerfile-based configuration with build secrets, improved layer caching (70% faster builds), and agent-led environment setup with validation.

title: Start Copilot cloud agent tasks via REST API
description: Developers can now initiate Copilot cloud agent tasks programmatically through REST API endpoints, enabling automation and integration into CI/CD pipelines.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 (fast mode)
description: Claude Opus 4.7 (fast mode) is now available in Windsurf, offering the full intelligence of Opus 4.7 but with approximately 2.5x higher output speeds.
